rollRule: Weighted draw without replacement by family (a higher weight is more common; the standard templates use 100, powerhouses 3-8); typed variants selected after family; inclusive integer values.

affixes.name: Type Focus
affixes.condition: Your moves of the chosen type deal more damage.

affixes.name: Physical Force
affixes.condition: Your physical moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Special Force
affixes.condition: Your special moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Healthy Force
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you are at 80% HP or more.

affixes.name: Last Stand
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you are at 35% HP or less.

affixes.name: Defiant Force
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you have a status condition.

affixes.name: Type Ward
affixes.condition: You take less damage from moves of the chosen type.

affixes.name: Healthy Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you are at 80% HP or more.

affixes.name: Steadfast Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you are at 35% HP or less.

affixes.name: Status Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you have a status condition.

affixes.name: Opening Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage from the first attack that hits you each battle.

affixes.name: Restorative
affixes.condition: Healing and draining moves you use restore more HP.

affixes.name: Type Mastery
affixes.condition: Your moves of the chosen type deal much more damage. Rare.

affixes.name: Overwhelming Force
affixes.condition: All your damaging moves deal more damage. Very rare.

affixes.name: Kindred Force
affixes.condition: Moves that match one of your own types deal more damage.

affixes.name: Executioner
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage to targets at 50% HP or less.

affixes.name: Opening Strike
affixes.condition: Your first damaging move after entering battle hits harder.

affixes.name: Super Effective Force
affixes.condition: Your super-effective moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Iron Resolve
affixes.condition: You take less damage from every move. Very rare.

affixes.name: Type Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take much less damage from moves of the chosen type. Rare.

affixes.name: Resilient Hide
affixes.condition: You take less damage from super-effective moves.

affixes.name: Triumphant
affixes.condition: When your move knocks out a target, you heal a share of your max HP.

affixes.name: Physical Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take less damage from physical moves.

affixes.name: Special Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take less damage from special moves.

affixes.name: Smoldering
affixes.condition: Burn damage on enemies you burned is stronger.

affixes.name: Venomous
affixes.condition: Regular poison damage on enemies you poisoned is stronger. Not Toxic.

affixes.name: Rending
affixes.condition: 30% chance per hit to cause bleeding: 1/12 max HP a turn, stacks to 3, lasts 3 turns. This boosts it.
